topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I walked into the gallery, the sun spilling in through the high windows, and there it was—a piece of me, now etched onto the skin of a stranger. At first, I blinked, thinking my eyes must be playing tricks on me. But the more I looked, the more I saw the intricate lines, the subtle shading, the way it moved with the soft shift of muscle beneath. It was as if my art had found a new canvas, a living, breathing form. I smiled, feeling a strange kinship with this anonymous admirer, who chose to carry a piece of my world with them, wherever they went. The gallery seemed a little brighter, the air a little sweeter, knowing my work could touch someone so deeply.
